creative_mode_tweaks.modedescription.pla: Builds a floor or wall based on the targeted face
creative_mode_tweaks.modedescription.mes: Choose a triangle or quad, then click its vertices to build an angled face.
creative_mode_tweaks.modedescription.pyr: Builds a pyramid outward from the face clicked first
creative_mode_tweaks.modedescription.dom: Builds a hemisphere outward from the face clicked first
creative_mode_tweaks.action.open_server_: Change reach, placement limits and what blocks you can break here.
creative_mode_tweaks.action.toggle_angel: Target the furthest available air block at the configured distance.
creative_mode_tweaks.action.toggle_night: Brighten the world and remove normal fog while enabled.
creative_mode_tweaks.action.toggle_nocli: Allow creative-mode movement through blocks while enabled.
creative_mode_tweaks.action.replace_only: You can only place blocks where there was air. Replaceables such as short grass and ferns can still be replaced.
creative_mode_tweaks.action.replace_bloc: You can replace blocks and air.
creative_mode_tweaks.action.replace_only: You can only replace blocks, not air.
creative_mode_tweaks.action.replace_filt: You can only replace blocks that match the block in your offhand.
creative_mode_tweaks.action.toggle_prote: If enabled, blocks that hold data such as chests, furnaces, and hoppers can not be replaced.
creative_mode_tweaks.message.only_break_: You can only break blocks that you placed this session
creative_mode_tweaks.message.only_replac: You can only replace blocks that you placed this session
creative_mode_tweaks.message.breaking_di: Breaking blocks with build modes is disabled in survival
creative_mode_tweaks.message.angel_place: Angel Placement is disabled in survival.
creative_mode_tweaks.message.too_hard: Some blocks exceeded the maximum hardness
creative_mode_tweaks.message.world_borde: Some blocks are outside the world border or build height
creative_mode_tweaks.message.sublevel_ou: A selection must stay within one simulated contraption or the world
creative_mode_tweaks.message.not_operato: Only admins can edit functional settings.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.reach.toolti: How far away you can place and break blocks with build modes.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.angel_placem: Distance from the player at which Angel Placement targets an air block.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.allow_angel_: If on, survival players can use Angel Placement.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.max_blocks_p: Maximum number of blocks placed in a single action.
Maximum size of a build mode shape along any axis.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.max_mirror_s: Maximum diameter for mirror and radial mirror modifiers.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.max_array_co: Maximum number of copies an array modifier can produce.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.max_array_of: Maximum offset distance for each array modifier axis.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.allow_breaki: If on, build modes can be used to break blocks.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.only_placed_: If on, you can only break blocks that were placed this session.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.max_hardness:
Maximum block hardness that can be broken. -1 = no limit.

Examples:
  0.5 = Dirt, Sand
  1.5 = Stone
  2.0 = Wood Planks, Logs
  4.5 = Ores
  50 = Obsidian
creative_mode_tweaks.config.require_tool: If on, you must have the correct tools in your inventory to break blocks.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.use_durabili: If on, breaking blocks will consume durability from the appropriate tool in your inventory.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.show_welcome: If on, each player receives the welcome message once per world.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.show_build_m: If on, each player receives the build-mode usage hint once per world.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.preview_bloc: Size of block previews as a percentage of a full block.
Transparency of block previews. 0% = invisible, 100% = solid.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.max_block_pr:
Maximum number of block models rendered in the preview.
Lower values improve performance with large shapes.
Outlines are always drawn for all blocks.
creative_mode_tweaks.config.protect_tile: If on, blocks that hold data such as chests, furnaces, and hoppers cannot be replaced or broken.
